messages:
Rory Bennett: Quick RFC follow-up: want to land a thin boundary between evaluators (signal producers) and actuators (enforcers). Keep evaluators pluggable and actuators policy-driven.
Mei Tan: Can you define "thin boundary"? What lives inside the envelope vs policy?
Rory Bennett: Envelope = typed, signed signal: {channel, severity, score, reason, expires_at, provenance, rollout_id}. Policy = mapping from envelope->action, plus safety budget and dwell-time rules.
Harold Green: Important: actuators should only do reversible ops without central signed approval. Eg: divert 50% or reduce cohort weight. Full model swap requires central signed command.
Zoe Rivera: Add a flight-recorder: persist envelope + raw metric slice + action taken. Retain 90d default. Useful for audits and blameless postmortems.
Mei Tan: How do we avoid oscillation from noisy signals? Suggest token-damper: each auto-action consumes a token; tokens refill slowly. Policy also enforces min_dwell_seconds per cohort.
Harold Green: Agreed. Also require monotonic hint versions and signature to avoid replay. Envelope example:
```
{ "channel": "latency", "severity": "critical", "score": 92, "reason": "p95+200ms", "expires_at": "2026-03-25T12:00:00Z", "provenance": ["latency-eval:v2"], "rollout_id": "r-20260325-09" }
```
Zoe Rivera: Local actuator behavior: cache envelope until expiry, apply policy mapping, log to flight-recorder, and if confidence high do fast reversible action. Central combiner can override within a short window.
Rory Bennett: Policy fields to standardize: min_dwell_seconds, max_auto_rollbacks_per_day, backoff_multiplier, emergency_threshold, allowed_actions (observe, partial_divert, quarantine, rollback).
Mei Tan: For canaries/A-B, envelope should include cohort_fraction and impact_estimate so actuator can scale response (e.g., % reduction).
Harold Green: Transport: gRPC push + signed envelope. Fallback: signed HTTP webhook. Envelopes must include nonce + seq_id.
Zoe Rivera: Circuit freeze rule: if >3 automated changes for same rollout in 15m -> freeze auto-actions for 30m and page oncall.
Ops Bot: deploy-bot: Canary started for ranking-service v4 cohort=3% at 2026-03-25T09:07Z :rocket:
Rory Bennett: Next steps: Mei will draft envelope proto + policy defaults, Harold prototypes local cache + token-damper, Zoe wires flight-recorder table. We'll land behind a feature flag and shadow for 2 weeks.
Mei Tan: I'll also add migration docs: how to toggle legacy controller per-service. :+1:
